description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application, which sets up the main user interface, including a fragment and logging features.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: The primary launcher activity that displays the main UI, manages fragments, and initializes logging.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets up the activity layout, initializes a fragment for synchronized notifications, and manages some UI components.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for the activity.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the custom logging chain with wrappers and filters, attaching it to a log display fragment.
